protocol.q_gate_definition: natural replay gate matrix g[:, pair]
protocol.forced_write_definition: forced pair softmax for the actual training/write path only
protocol.pair_delta_definition: L2 current pair parameters minus trajectory-start pair parameters
protocol.hazard_model: trajectory-clustered GEE, Binomial, Independence, robust covariance

theta0_anchor_limitation: theta0 is the task-0 checkpoint and is used as the historical functional anchor for theta1 and theta2. At theta2, theta0 does not encode the post-task-1 state; therefore the quantity is an anchor-to-theta0 retention direction rather than a complete all-old-tasks direction.
state_task_confound: theta1 uses incoming task T2 while theta2 uses incoming task T3. Therefore contains_7 × C(state) cannot isolate a pure checkpoint-state effect from an incoming-task effect.
rerivation_note: Re-derivation from the trajectory log agreed to 11 digits on Model A contains_7 and on both expert-7 hypergeometric p-values, and differed on Model B and Model C pair_delta coefficients by ~10–13%, most likely due to a difference in person-period row retention near the event step. The JSON is authoritative.
